_doc: Surrogate constants that cannot be parsed from the game (aggregate stand-ins for systems the surrogate omits) or that calibrate.py fits. Each entry names its source. Constants that CAN be parsed (effect limits, era ceilings, adoption pace, life table, cohort durations, early-care categories, conception rates, food yields, artifact constants...) are read live from GDScript by gamedata.py and are deliberately absent here. 'fit': true marks free constants calibrate.py adjusts; its results are written to the 'calibrated' section which overrides the defaults.

substeps_per_month.source: surrogate: demography/food sub-steps per month (game: daily)

disease_pressure.source: environment hazards.disease (consequence_engine.gd Illness/health cost); headless probe profile

knowledge_effective_factor.source: game_state.gd effective_workers(Knowledge): minus clinical care / microscopy / scholar-visit reservations (truth: effective = assigned in these runs)

food_buffer.source: GovernmentPeopleSystem automatic work: food labor held above need (government_people_system.gd)

food_adjust_rate.source: surrogate smoothing of automatic food labor (per month)

shelter_bonus.source: consequence_engine.gd health_target: Hearth Circle 0.05 + Lean-to Shelters 0.12 once built

health_offset.source: residual of consequence_engine.gd health_target terms the surrogate omits (clinical care, exchange, policies)

cohesion_offset.source: residual of cohesion_target omitted terms (values, economy, governance)

education_offset.source: leadership subcategory effect on Preserved knowledge / Communication (society_model.gd evaluate_subcategories)

housing_build_rate.source: construction output -> housing capacity (settlement build system); housing places per builder-day

housing_target_ratio.source: settlement auto-build keeps housing ahead of population (observed)

completed_per_year.source: truth runs: all five founding works (Hearth Circle, Lean-to Shelters, Storage Pits, Open Work Area, Gathering Yard) finish within the first year

storage_pits_year.source: Storage Pits is one of the founding works finished in year 1 (settlement_construction.gd)

settlement_population.source: people per additional settlement (auto settlement; truth runs stay at 1 settlement through year 100)

accessible_deposits_per_decade.source: resource deposits reaching 'accessible' (resource system) for material_target

openness.source: societal_values lived openness/pluralism (artifact_culture.gd allure values term)

founding_works.source: settlement_construction.gd works without discovery gates (Hearth Circle, Lean-to Shelters, Storage Pits, Open Work Area, Gathering Yard)

build_delay_years.source: years from a work's discovery to its completion (build queue)

fresh_spoil_mult.source: DiscoverySystem.food_storage_multipliers: preservation_profile reductions of known practices on fresh food (food_system.gd _spoilage_rates)

knowledge_gain_mult.source: consequence_engine.gd knowledge_gain modifiers the surrogate omits (curious_youth, founding knowledge_gain, societal values, progression knowledge_rate)

other_mortality.source: consequence_engine.gd mortality components not modeled individually (Work accidents, Dehydration, cold/heat exposure); annual rate

ai_settlement_until.source: AI seats found about one daughter settlement per 30 years; the surrogate stops that rule at 12 settlements (year 360) and follows population afterwards (research_3000).

expansion_environment.source: research_3000: territory settlements at which a growing realm's daughter settlements reach the coast and dry country (Research600 environment tags are any settlement's); not applied with headless_world

headless_world.source: research_3000: true mirrors the headless truth-probe world (calibrate.py/check.py set it): no Freshwater deposit past recognized, one site's environment

found_crowding.source: research_3000 surrogate player model: crowding (population over 60% of carrying capacity, EarlyLifeConditions) at which a realm founds a daughter settlement; not applied with headless_world

found_interval_years.source: research_3000 surrogate player model: at most one daughter settlement per this many years

found_from_year.source: research_3000 surrogate player model: daughter settlements from this year (the 0-600 balance was fitted to one territory, BENCHMARKS_600)

throughput.source: lumped leader factor x diplomacy x figures x direction x communities x consequences.discovery_multiplier x Pathways.multiplier (discovery_system.gd process_day)

throughput_growth.source: log-linear drift of the lumped factor per century (officials' skill, communities)

opening_gate_delay_years.source: OpeningOpportunities evidence days before gated items open (opening_opportunities.gd)

context.source: civilization_day.gd context(): default activity signals (+Hearth Circle)

signal_scale.source: scale on context signals (field observations, military context add to them)

resource_known_year.source: resource deposits recognized (resource system); scenario may override; research_3000 adds the later deposits a growing realm finds or trades for (lead, silver and gold ores early; graphite, oil, phosphate, nickel, bauxite and uranium with industry)

resource_stage_lag.source: years from recognition to each deposit stage (resource system)

resource_stage_year_override.source: Observed in every headless truth run: the Freshwater deposit never passes 'recognized' (no terrain/hydrology deposit), so items needing Freshwater 'accessible' (wound_cleaning, clean_water, birth_attendants...) never open. Verify in the real game; set to years to model a mapped river site. research_3000: applied only with headless_world (calibration runs against the headless truth); benchmark runs model a mapped river site.

resource_potential.source: environment resource_potentials used by research_affinity (+15 x potential per requirement)

throughput_growth_until.source: years over which the fitted throughput drift applies (the truth runs' horizon); constant afterwards. A later-era real-engine spot check (ground_truth/*_start*) measures the lumped factor there as throughput_late.

goods_coverage.source: CivilianGoods.coverage() (stock / target) that scales FoodSystem technique levers; the surrogate has no goods stocks, so a lumped share (research_3000). Checked by the later-era spot check.

party_size.source: scouting_staff.gd party size (2..80, share of the target)

cells_per_trip.source: new 24 km cells searched per trip (route novelty >= 0.38)

ground_density.source: artifact_sites.gd density(ground): mean over scouted terrain (0.04-0.62)

explored_area_cells.source: reachable uncharted cells; searched ground is never re-searched at random

rival_claim_rate.source: share of remaining sites/cells claimed by rival parties per year (site_claimed exclusivity)

legend_reach_cells.source: legendary sites 160-2560 km from home; chance a trip passes one
